ModelAssignments.Title: Model Assignments
ModelAssignments.Subtitle: Choose which model handles each part of the workflow.
ModelAssignments.NoModelsFound: No models were returned for this provider. Enter the model name or ID manually.
ModelAssignments.Primary: Does most of the heavy lifting (answering questions, writing, and reasoning through your requests). This is the model you'll interact with the most.
ModelAssignments.Triage: Handles the classification of incoming requests (and job) so they can be routed appropriately, before the primary model gets involved. Defaults to the Primary model if unset.
ModelAssignments.Discovery: Used for exploration (searching, digging through context, and gathering information). Defaults to the Primary model if unset.
